source.publication: 2025 Oklahoma Resident Individual Income Tax Forms and Instructions (Form 511 packet)
source.section: Form 511 lines 1-14 and 18 (PDF pages 42-43); select line instructions (PDF pages 9-10); standard deduction line 10 (PDF page 10); exemptions line 11 and the Regular exemption terms (PDF pages 8 and 10); Tax Table (PDF pages 27-38); tax computation worksheets for 100,000 or more (PDF page 38)

worked: Federal AGI = wages (you) 157,350.00 = 157,350.00. Federal taxable income = 157,350.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 141,600.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Oklahoma starts from federal AGI). Form 511: line 1 federal AGI 157,350.00; line 2 subtractions 0.00; line 3 = 157,350.00 - 0.00 = 157,350.00; line 4 out-of-state income 0.00; line 5 157,350.00; line 6 additions 0.00; line 7 Oklahoma AGI 157,350.00; line 8 adjustments 0.00; line 9 157,350.00; line 10 standard deduction (single) 6,350.00; line 11 exemptions: 1 Regular + 0 Special = 1 x 1,000.00 = 1,000.00 (no one is 65 or older, 0 Special); line 12 = 6,350.00 + 1,000.00 = 7,350.00; line 13 taxable income = 157,350.00 - 7,350.00 = 150,000.00; line 14 tax (the projection's brackets as numbers; the booklet prints only a table and worksheets): 0.25% x 1,000.00 = 2.5000 + 0.75% x 1,500.00 = 11.2500 + 1.75% x 1,250.00 = 21.8750 + 2.75% x 1,150.00 = 31.6250 + 3.75% x 2,300.00 = 86.2500 + 4.75% x 142,800.00 = 6,783.0000; total 6,936.5000 = 6,936.50. Line 13 is 100,000 or more, so the form uses the worksheet on PDF page 38 (single or married filing separate): 4,562 + 0.0475 x 50,000.00 = 6,937.00; expected keeps the schedule figure. Lines 15-17 credits 0.00; line 18 income tax 6,936.50. The worksheet starts from the rounded 4,562, so it is 0.50 above the schedule; the projection's approximation allows this.
accepted_approximations: The brackets are derived from the printed tax table and the 100,000-and-over worksheets; the booklet prints no schedule. Below 100,000 tax is figured on the exact income, where the booklet taxes each 50-dollar row at its midpoint and rounds. At 100,000 and over the single and separate worksheet starts from 4,562 where the schedule gives 4,561.50.
